newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Ashton in Angola diamond mine pact.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Ashton in Angola diamond mine pact.

text.p: Ashton Mining Ltd said on Tuesday it has been granted approval to particiapte in an Angolan alluvial diamond mining project through Angola's Sociedade De Desenvolvimento Mineiro de Angola SARL (SDM).
The project is located in the Cuango River region of Lunde Norte Province, Ashton said.
Development of the mine is conditional on a United Nations peace accord being fulfilled, Ashton said.
The Cuango River region is occupied by UNITA rebel forces, which are currently conducting mining operations there, Ashton's executive director of finance and administration, Douglas Bailey said.
"Obviously we can't enter that region until the UNITA depart," Bailey told Reuters.
Under the UN peace accord, the UNITA forces have agreed to leave the region, enabling Ashton acces to the mine early next year, he said.
